info.title: OPERA Cloud Cashiering API
info.description:
APIs to cater for Cashiering related functionality in OPERA Cloud.

Cashiering provides access to a guest folio, posting journals, receipt histories, currency calculations, credit card settlements, and check a guest out.

Compatible with OPERA Cloud release 26.3.0.0.

get.description:
This API is used to fetch the folios for a given reservation. A guest reservation could have 1 or more folios per reservation. Folios will only exist for a reservation once the guest has checked into the hotel.

OperationId:getFolio

This API allows a time span of 30 days.

parameters.name: guestPayOnly
parameters.description: Flag to return the Folio Windows information where the Reservation Guest is the Payee, i.e the Folio Window is not Routed to another Reservation or another Profile.

parameters.name: includeFolioHistory
parameters.description: This flag will notify the service if the folio history will also be returned or not.

parameters.name: reservationBalanceOnly
parameters.description: This flag will notify the service if the reservation summary information will be returned. If TRUE then we will only return the reservation's outstanding balance.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The ending value of the date range.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Indicates maximum number of records a Web Service should return.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Index or initial index of the set(page) being requested. If the index goes out of the bounds of the total set count then no data will be returned.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: The starting value of the date range.

parameters.name: summaryOnly
parameters.description: This flag will notify the service that transactional postings will not be returned.

parameters.name: exchangeCurrency
parameters.description: Currency to which the Credit and Debit Amounts will be converted for each Folio. The response will have the ExchangeAmounts element with the converted amounts. The Posting Exchange Rate of the current business date will be used for the conversion

parameters.name: simpleFolio
parameters.description: This flag signifies that generated Folio is Normal or Simple Folio. Certain countries of the World mandate a simple folio when the invoice amount is less than defined threshold.
